name: Suzhou K-Hiragawa Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou K-Hiragawa Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, design, development, production, and sale of functional devices for consumer electronics and new energy vehicle power batteries in China and internationally. The company offers battery-related, structural, and optical functional devices. It also provides optical communication equipment, electronic components, new materials, and technology products. The company exports its products. Suzhou K-Hiragawa Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2012 and is based in Kunshan, China.
